# Set up the environment
```{r}
# ---- Clear the environment ----
rm(list=ls()) # (Optional) Clear the environment

# ---- Load libraries ----
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(gstat)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# ---- Set file paths ----
folder_path <- "/Users/becca/Documents/current projects/Manuscript Storm Wali" # Folder location
input_path  <- file.path(folder_path, "data") # Where to find input files
output_path <- file.path(folder_path, "output") # Where to save output files
```

# Wrangle the data
```{r}
# Input file
meta <- read_csv(file.path(input_path, "processed/physicochemistry/sample_data.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE)

# Subset
site_list <- c("P1","P2","P3","P4","P5","P6","P7","P8","P9","P10")
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(as.character(Date), format = "%Y%m%d")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date),
         Date >= as.Date("2014-07-07"),
         Date <= as.Date("2014-08-11")) %>%
  filter(Site %in% site_list)

# Variable sets
vars_ysi  <- c("S_Temp_C","B_Temp_C",
               "S_Salinity_ppt","B_Salinity_ppt",
               "S_DO_mgL","B_DO_mgL",
               "S_pH","B_pH")
vars_hach <- c("NO2_uM","NO3_uM","PO4_uM","NH3_uM","SiO2_uM","Turb_FAU")
vars_all <- c(vars_ysi, vars_hach)


# Pivot to long format (THIS CREATES var and value)
df_long <- meta %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = any_of(vars_all),   # use vars_all; any_of is safer
    names_to  = "var",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    layer = case_when(
      grepl("^S_", var) ~ "S",
      grepl("^B_", var) ~ "B",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

# QC flags
## Flag computation
```{r}
df_hach <- df_long %>%
  filter(var %in% vars_hach)

# ---- Flag 1: robust MAD flag within Date × layer × var ----
flag_mad_within_group <- function(df_hach, mad_cut = 2.5, min_n = 4) {
  df_hach %>%
    group_by(Date, layer, var) %>%
    mutate(
      n_group = sum(!is.na(value)),
      med = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      md  = mad(value, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      z_mad = ifelse(is.na(md) | md == 0, 0, (value - med) / md),
      flag_mad = !is.na(value) & n_group >= min_n & (abs(z_mad) >= mad_cut)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-med, -md, -n_group)
}

# ---- Flag 2: spatial neighbor flag ----
flag_loo_idw <- function(df,
                         z_cut = 2,
                         power = 2,
                         min_n = 3,
                         crs_proj = 32604) {
  
  out <- df %>%
    mutate(
      idw_pred = NA_real_,
      idw_resid = NA_real_,
      z_resid = NA_real_,
      flag_spatial = FALSE
    )
  
  groups <- out %>% distinct(Date, layer, var)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
    
    d  <- groups$Date[i]
    ly <- groups$layer[i]
    vv <- groups$var[i]
    
    # FIX: Handle NA layer properly
    if (is.na(ly)) {
      idx <- which(out$Date == d &
                     is.na(out$layer) &
                     out$var == vv &
                     !is.na(out$value) &
                     !is.na(out$Lon) & !is.na(out$Lat))
    } else {
      idx <- which(out$Date == d &
                     out$layer == ly &
                     out$var == vv &
                     !is.na(out$value) &
                     !is.na(out$Lon) & !is.na(out$Lat))
    }
    
    n <- length(idx)
    if (n < min_n) next
    
    sub <- out[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    sub_sf <- st_as_sf(sub, coords = c("Lon", "Lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
      st_transform(crs_proj)
    xy <- st_coordinates(sub_sf)
    
    pred <- rep(NA_real_, n)
    
    # Leave-one-out IDW prediction
    for (r in seq_len(n)) {
      
      dists <- sqrt((xy[r, 1] - xy[-r, 1])^2 + (xy[r, 2] - xy[-r, 2])^2)
      vals  <- sub$value[-r]
      
      weights <- 1 / (dists^power + 1e-10)
      weights <- weights / sum(weights)
      
      pred[r] <- sum(weights * vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    resid <- sub$value - pred
    
    # Standardize residuals
    resid_spread <- sd(resid, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (is.na(resid_spread) || resid_spread == 0) {
      z_resid <- rep(0, n)
    } else {
      z_resid <- resid / resid_spread
    }
    
    out$idw_pred[idx]     <- pred
    out$idw_resid[idx]    <- resid
    out$z_resid[idx]      <- z_resid
    out$flag_spatial[idx] <- abs(z_resid) >= z_cut
  }
  
  out
}
```

## Run flags
```{r}
# Stage 1 (MAD): Run on df_hach
qc_stage1 <- flag_mad_within_group(df_hach, mad_cut = 2.5)

# Stage 2 (Spatial LOO-IDW): Run on df_hach separately
qc_stage2 <- flag_loo_idw(df_hach, z_cut = 2, power = 2)

# Combine: Join the spatial flag back to Stage 1 results
df_hach_qc <- qc_stage1 %>%
  left_join(
    qc_stage2 %>%
      select(Desc_Sample_ID, var, idw_pred, idw_resid, z_resid, flag_spatial),
    by = c("Desc_Sample_ID", "var")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    instrument = case_when(
      var %in% vars_ysi  ~ "YSI",
      var %in% vars_hach ~ "Hach",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    flag_any = coalesce(flag_mad, FALSE) | coalesce(flag_spatial, FALSE),
    
    flag_questionable = case_when(
      instrument == "Hach" ~ (coalesce(flag_mad, FALSE) & coalesce(flag_spatial, FALSE)),
      instrument == "YSI"  ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    
    qc_status = case_when(
      instrument == "YSI"  & flag_any ~ "YSI_flag_diagnostic",
      instrument == "YSI"             ~ "YSI_kept",
      instrument == "Hach" & flag_questionable ~ "Hach_questionable",
      instrument == "Hach"                     ~ "Hach_kept",
      TRUE                                     ~ "unclassified"
    )
  )

# Verify the join worked
df_hach_qc %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_rows = n(),
    has_mad_flag = sum(!is.na(flag_mad)),
    has_spatial_flag = sum(!is.na(flag_spatial)),
    n_mad_true = sum(flag_mad, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_spatial_true = sum(flag_spatial, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_both = sum(flag_mad & flag_spatial, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_questionable = sum(flag_questionable, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Summarize flags
```{r}
# Summarize flags by variable
(flag_summary_var <- df_hach_qc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
  summarize(
    n_total        = sum(!is.na(value)),
    n_flagged      = sum(flag_any & !is.na(value), na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_flagged    = round(100 * n_flagged / n_total, 1),
    n_mad_only     = sum(flag_mad & !flag_spatial & !is.na(value), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_spatial_only = sum(!flag_mad & flag_spatial & !is.na(value), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_both         = sum(flag_mad & flag_spatial & !is.na(value), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_flagged)))

# Are flags consistently tied to specific sites?
df_hach_qc %>%
  dplyr::filter(flag_any, !is.na(value)) %>%
  dplyr::count(var, Site) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Site,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    var,
    any_of(site_list)
  ) # Notes: Missing sites have zero flagged values across all variables


# Are flags consistently tied to specific dates?
df_hach_qc %>%
  dplyr::filter(flag_any, !is.na(value)) %>%
  dplyr::count(var, Date) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%        
  dplyr::arrange(Date) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Date,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) # Notes: Missing dates have zero flagged values across all variables

# Do the flag values violate physical plausibility?
df_hach_qc %>%
  filter(var %in% vars_hach, !is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(var) %>%
  summarize(
    min_flagged = min(value),
    max_flagged = max(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
plot_hist_flag <- function(var_name, bins = 30) {
  df_hach_qc %>%
    filter(var == var_name, !is.na(value)) %>%
    mutate(
      flag_type = case_when(
        flag_mad & flag_spatial ~ "Both",
        flag_mad ~ "MAD only",
        flag_spatial ~ "Spatial only",
        TRUE ~ "Kept"
      ),
      flag_type = factor(
        flag_type,
        levels = c("Kept", "MAD only", "Spatial only", "Both")
      )
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = flag_type)) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = bins,
      color = "black",
      position = "identity",

        "Kept"  = "grey90",
        "MAD only"     = "blue",
        "Spatial only" = "red",
        "Both"         = "purple"
      ),
      name = "QC flag type"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Raw distribution:", var_name),
      x = var_name,
      y = "Count"
    )
}
```

## Remove flagged values
```{r}
# Overwrite value for flagged Hach values
df_hach_qc_nas <- df_hach_qc %>%
  mutate(
    instrument = "Hach",
    flag_any = coalesce(flag_mad, FALSE) | coalesce(flag_spatial, FALSE),
    value = if_else(flag_any, NA_real_, value),  # Remove if either flag is TRUE
    layer = NA_character_
  )

# YSI: unchanged (pulled from df_long)
df_ysi <- df_long %>%
  filter(var %in% vars_ysi)

# Combine
df_final_qc <- bind_rows(df_ysi, df_hach_qc_nas) %>%
  arrange(Date, Site, var)
stopifnot(length(setdiff(vars_all, unique(df_final_qc$var))) == 0) # Sanity check

# Sanity check
df_final_qc %>%
  group_by(var) %>%
  summarize(
    n_na = sum(is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_na))
```

# Replace missing values
## IDW imputation
```{r}
impute_idw_overwrite <- function(df,
                                 value_col = "value",
                                 x_col = "Lon",
                                 y_col = "Lat",
                                 id_col = "Desc_Sample_ID",
                                 power = 2,
                                 k = 5,
                                 min_n = 3,
                                 crs_ll = 4326,
                                 crs_proj = 32604,
                                 keep_diag = TRUE) {

  stopifnot(all(c("Date","var","layer", x_col, y_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))

  out <- df %>%
    mutate(
      was_imputed = FALSE  # optional diagnostic; can be dropped at end
    )

  groups <- out %>% distinct(Date, var, layer)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {

    d  <- groups$Date[i]
    vv <- groups$var[i]
    ly <- groups$layer[i]

    # ---- NA-safe layer indexing (Hach has layer = NA) ----
    if (is.na(ly)) {
      idx <- which(out$Date == d & out$var == vv & is.na(out$layer))
    } else {
      idx <- which(out$Date == d & out$var == vv & out$layer == ly)
    }
    if (length(idx) == 0) next
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    sub <- out[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    # Only rows with coords are eligible for imputation
    sub <- sub %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[x_col]]), !is.na(.data[[y_col]]))

    # observed vs missing (ONLY missing will be overwritten)
    obs <- sub %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[value_col]]))
    mis <- sub %>% filter(is.na(.data[[value_col]]))

    if (nrow(mis) == 0) next
    if (nrow(obs) < min_n) next

    obs_sf <- st_as_sf(obs, coords = c(x_col, y_col), crs = crs_ll, remove = FALSE) %>%
      st_transform(crs_proj)
    mis_sf <- st_as_sf(mis, coords = c(x_col, y_col), crs = crs_ll, remove = FALSE) %>%
      st_transform(crs_proj)

    k_use <- min(k, nrow(obs))

    pred <- gstat::idw(
      formula   = as.formula(paste0(value_col, " ~ 1")),
      locations = obs_sf,
      newdata   = mis_sf,
      idp       = power,
      nmax      = k_use
    )

    # Write predictions directly into out[[value_col]] for the NA rows
    mis_ids <- mis[[id_col]]
    write_idx <- idx[match(mis_ids, out[[id_col]][idx])]

    out[[value_col]][write_idx] <- pred$var1.pred
    out$was_imputed[write_idx]  <- !is.na(pred$var1.pred)
  }

  if (!keep_diag) out <- out %>% select(-was_imputed)

  out
}
```

## Run imputation
```{r}
df_final_qc_overwrite <- impute_idw_overwrite(
  df_final_qc,
  value_col = "value",
  k = 5,
  min_n = 3,
  power = 2,
  keep_diag = FALSE   # <- set TRUE if you want to briefly audit what changed
)

# Summarize changes to missing values
df_final_qc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_missing_before = sum(is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    df_final_qc_overwrite %>%
      dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(
        n_missing_after = sum(is.na(value)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "var"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_missing_before))
```

## Overwrite final pchem values 
```{r}
df_final_qc_overwrite_wide <- df_final_qc_overwrite %>%
  dplyr::select(Desc_Sample_ID, var, value) %>%
  distinct() %>%   # safety: ensure one row per sample×var
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = var,
    values_from = value

meta_qc <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(vars_all)) %>%                                     # drop original measurement columns

stopifnot(identical(names(meta_qc), names(meta)) & identical(meta_qc$Desc_Sample_ID, meta$Desc_Sample_ID)) # sanity check
```

## Save processed data
```{r}
# Transform data and calculate molecular ratios
meta_qc_trans <- meta_qc %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(NO3_uM, NO2_uM, NH3_uM, PO4_uM, SiO2_uM, Turb_FAU),
      ~ log10(.x + 1),
      .names = "{.col}_t"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tin = NO3_uM + NO2_uM + NH3_uM,

    tin_to_tip = if_else(PO4_uM == 0, NA_real_, tin / PO4_uM),
    tin_to_sil = if_else(SiO2_uM == 0, NA_real_, tin / SiO2_uM),
    sil_to_sal = if_else(S_Salinity_ppt == 0, NA_real_, SiO2_uM / S_Salinity_ppt),

    across(
      c(tin, tin_to_tip, tin_to_sil, sil_to_sal),
      ~ log10(.x + 1),
      .names = "{.col}_t"
    )
  )


# Re-read original and pull OM2 rows for the same date window
om2 <- read_csv(file.path(input_path, "processed/physicochemistry/sample_data.csv"),
                show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(as.character(Date), format = "%Y%m%d")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date),
         Date >= as.Date("2014-07-07"),
         Date <= as.Date("2014-08-11"),
         !Site %in% site_list)  # everything NOT in P1-P10, i.e. OM2

# Bind — missing columns in om2 will fill with NA automatically
meta_qc_trans_full <- bind_rows(meta_qc_trans, om2) %>%
  arrange(Date, Site)

# Save to file
write.csv(
  meta_qc_trans_full,
  file.path(output_path, "../data/processed/physicochemistry/sample_data_qc_imputed.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

meta_qc_trans_full
```

# Summary of quality control and imputation.

**Plain-language summary**
We carefully reviewed all water-quality measurements to identify values that appeared inconsistent with nearby sampling locations. For each measurement, we compared its value to what would be expected based on neighboring sites sampled on the same day—values that differed substantially from their spatial neighbors were flagged for review. Handheld colorimetric measurements (used for nutrients and turbidity) are more sensitive to procedural variability than in-water sensors, so we applied an additional statistical filter to these data; only values flagged by both methods were removed. Sensor-based measurements (YSI) showed strong spatial consistency and were retained as measured. Any missing or removed values were then estimated using inverse distance weighting from nearby locations sampled on the same day, allowing us to fill small gaps without altering overall spatial patterns.

**Publication-ready summary**
We applied a two-stage quality-control procedure combining robust MAD filtering and leave-one-out spatial consistency checks to identify and remove potentially unreliable colorimetric nutrient and turbidity values prior to analysis. YSI sensor measurements showed strong spatial consistency and were retained without modification. Missing and removed values were interpolated using inverse distance weighting (IDW) within sampling date and variable groups, using spatially-proximal observations to preserve observed gradients.
